description: This PHP source file provides the backend and frontend code for adding a device to a blocked list within a content control management system. It includes HTML markup, embedded JavaScript for UI interactions and validation, PHP includes for shared components, and server-side logic to process device blocking with time and day configurations.

methods.description: Returns a list of device instance IDs based on a specified query.

methods.description: Fetches parameter values for instances, returning device information such as hostname and MAC address.
